title: Academic claim verification + fact-check — peer-reviewed source validation again
description: Academic claim verification + fact-check — peer-reviewed source validation against Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Perplexity. For research agents, scientific due diligence, regulatory dossiers (EMA, EFSA, FDA), academic compliance. ~17s, premium tier.
